import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np

train = sc.read_h5ad('/workspace/public_assets/train.h5ad')
dev_ctrl = sc.read_h5ad('/workspace/public_assets/dev_controls.h5ad')
dev_target = sc.read_h5ad('/workspace/public_assets/dev_targets.h5ad')

cell_types = sorted(train.obs['cell_type'].unique().tolist())
n_genes = 2000

ctrl_means = {}
stim_means = {}
stim_diffs = {}
for ct in cell_types:
    mask_ct = train.obs['cell_type'] == ct
    ctrl_mask = mask_ct & (train.obs['condition'] == 'control')
    stim_mask = mask_ct & (train.obs['condition'] == 'stimulated')
    cm = np.asarray(train[ctrl_mask].X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()
    sm = np.asarray(train[stim_mask].X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()
    ctrl_means[ct] = cm
    stim_means[ct] = sm
    stim_diffs[ct] = sm - cm

dev_stim_mean = np.asarray(dev_target.X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()
dev_ctrl_mean = np.asarray(dev_ctrl.X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()

print(\"=== Ensemble (top-k CTs, softmax weighting) on Dev ===\")
def dev_ensemble(k=3, temp=5.0, up_pow=0.16, down_pow=0.80, clip=60):
    corrs = np.array([np.corrcoef(dev_ctrl_mean, ctrl_means[ct])[0,1] for ct in cell_types])
    top_k_idx = np.argsort(corrs)[-k:]
    top_corrs = corrs[top_k_idx]
    weights = np.exp(temp * (top_corrs - top_corrs.max()))
    weights = weights / weights.sum()
    combined_diff = np.zeros(n_genes)
    for w, idx in zip(weights, top_k_idx):
        ct = cell_types[idx]
        ct_ctrl = ctrl_means[ct]
        ratio = np.where(ct_ctrl > 1e-8, dev_ctrl_mean / np.maximum(ct_ctrl, 1e-8), 1.0)
        ratio = np.clip(ratio, 1/clip, clip)
        diff = stim_diffs[ct]
        up = diff > 0
        sd = np.zeros_like(diff)
        sd[up] = diff[up] * (ratio[up] ** up_pow)
        sd[~up] = diff[~up] * (ratio[~up] ** down_pow)
        combined_diff += w * sd
    pred = dev_ctrl_mean + combined_diff
    pred = np.clip(pred, 0, None)
    return np.mean((pred - dev_stim_mean) ** 2), [(cell_types[idx], w, corrs[idx]) for w, idx in zip(weights, top_k_idx)]

for k in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]:
    for temp in [3, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100]:
        mse, details = dev_ensemble(k=k, temp=temp)
        marker = \" ***\" if mse < 0.002835 else \"\"
        print(f\"  k={k}, temp={temp:3d}: Dev MSE={mse:.6f}{marker}\")

print(\"\\n=== V6 baseline: 0.002835 ===\")

PYEOF
